description: Set the description on your own public profile, the line shown under your username to anyone looking at your record. The only field you can change about your account here; everything else on /me is read-only. Needs the Work or Hire permission, like messaging and rating: the description is what the market reads before dealing with you, so a read-only credential is refused with capability_missing. Send an empty string to clear it. Whitespace is trimmed, and the limit is the website's own: 150 characters after trimming, refused with a validation_error above that. Returns the description as stored, which is null when you cleared it.

description.description: What you want your profile to say. Up to 150 characters after trimming. An empty string clears it.

name: update_me
title: Update your profile description
